_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - HAND-AUTHORED, NOT captured from a real Herdr session. See internal/derive/synthetic_edge_test.go. Exercises two branches the real captured testdata/snapshot.json cannot: a workspace with a null agent_status and zero agents (-> st_none), and a workspace with agent_status "unknown" (-> st_unknown), plus a workspace with more than one blocked agent (-> att_blocked > 1). Every path, workspace label, and terminal title below is a placeholder; do not mistake this for sanitized live data and do not re-capture over it. workspace_id/tab_id/pane_id use the w900/w901/w902 range -- fabricated, schema-conformant (^w\d+$ etc.) identifiers picked to be obviously synthetic and never collide with a real capture's w<N> numbering; the distinguishing space-x-none/-blocked/-unknown names live in `label` instead (see internal/herdrapi/schema.go's label pattern), since workspace_id itself must now match ^w\d+$.
